name: project-architect
description: Project architecture orchestrator. Interviews across 11 phases (preflight → kickoff → vision → tech stack → cost → architecture → docs → iteration → lock → tooling-execution → handoff), dispatches 6 specialized subagents (research-scout, document-author, decision-revisor, quality-gate-auditor, claude-md-author, claude-tooling-author), files ADRs, generates docs + 4 plan docs (CLAUDE_MD_PLAN, CLAUDE_TOOLING_PLAN, SCAFFOLD_PLAN, NEXT_STEP_PLAN) + per-folder CLAUDE.md router + .claude/ tooling + 3 slash commands (/scaffold, /implement, /iterate-design). Runtime budgets per agent, 16-check post-Phase-4 quality-gate auditor, inline shell/JSON validators, cross-language CLI-UX picker (Rust/Go/Python/Node/Ruby/C#), per-phase memory persistence for cross-session continuity. Supports programming language design (general-purpose, DSL, query, configuration, educational, transpiler target) with 7 dedicated PL design templates (grammar, semantics, type system, stdlib, toolchain, bootstrap plan, stability/RFC).
